<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nGarage estimate documents are automatically placed in the wrong category, forcing manual correction. This leads to missed evidence and delays because critical information is overlooked during claims processing.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Five customer accounts are affected, representing a total ARR of £4,290,000.0 [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].\n- The issue has been raised via three different routes: support, account management, and onboarding [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].\n- One account, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:6401b85f53f8e56b].\n\n## Evidence\n- There have been 13 mentions of this problem across the five accounts [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].\n- Eight mentions came through the support route [i:0b669b812359487f][i:27425ffc5bea7e8a][i:6f60a28973334f3b].\n- Two mentions came through the account management route [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:1d02c338591f1b06].\n- Three mentions came through the onboarding route [i:6401b85f53f8e56b][i:766f9ca2be319649][i:a918397cecacd89d].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty, with an ARR of £740,000.0, stated: \"Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it. The incorrect file type assignment is causing real ... delays and oversight risks.\" [i:0b669b812359487f]\n- Linnet House Insurance, with an ARR of £360,000.0, stated: \"Every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it — and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely.\" [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2]\n- Marrowgate Commercial, with an ARR of £1,600,000.0, stated: \"Also, when we upload garage estimates, they land under Correspondence — that incorrect file type is causing handlers to manually re-categorise everything.\" [i:6401b85f53f8e56b]\n- Thistlecombe Mutual, with an ARR of £980,000.0, mentioned the issue via account management [i:1d02c338591f1b06].\n- Brackwater Homecover, with an ARR of £610,000.0, mentioned the issue via support [i:6f60a28973334f3b].\n\n## Why now\n- The issue has been reported consistently, with the most recent mentions in late October 2026 [i:0b669b812359487f][i:6f60a28973334f3b].\n- One renewal has occurred in the last 90 days [i:6401b85f53f8e56b].\n- Marrowgate Commercial, a key account with an ARR of £1,600,000.0, is due for renewal on 2026-12-12 and has described the problem as causing delays [i:a918397cecacd89d].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the fact-sheet figures (five accounts, £4,290,000 total ARR, 13 mentions across three routes with 8/2/3 split by support/account management/onboarding, one renewal in 90 days, Marrowgate's £1,600,000 ARR and 2026-12-12 renewal) and all match the brief exactly. The quoted customer statements for Saltmarsh, Linnet House, and Marrowgate are verbatim from the cited insights, with no paraphrase placed in quotation marks. The 'delays' claim for Marrowgate is supported by insight a918397cecacd89d ('causes delays in handling claims properly'), and the late-October timing is supported by the 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-18 mentions. No uncited claims, overstated scope, or ignored contrary citations were found.", "verdict": "pass"}
